verdict.rationale: Fern's core product generates type-safe, official SDKs across TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, Ruby, PHP, C#, confirmed by both first-party docs/GitHub and independent community commentary describing it as a 'robust end-to-end Developer Experience' covering SDKs. Missing for 10: hands-on/probe verification of an actual generated SDK's code quality or usage, and no independent review beyond the single HN comment.
